source.text: 1. A point is that of which there is no part.

source_claims.requirement: Identify the concept introduced as point and give its domain and representation.
Represent the partlessness condition with an explicit meaning of part; a coordinate pair or a name alone is not evidence of that condition.

interpretation_decisions.question: What notion of part is adopted, and why does it faithfully model this source definition?
How is the coordinate carrier distinguished from the geometric concept of a point?
